title: Grey-box test map layout
description: The developer test map (ADR-006 M3): one straight lane with a start for each side at either end. The network tests build it at runtime and the map commandlet saves it as a map. Map geometry, not gameplay tuning; units are Unreal units.

floor.description: A flat box centred on the origin whose top face is at height 0.

teamStarts.description: Team A starts at negative X and Team B at positive X, on the centre line.

distanceFromCenterX.description: Distance of each start from the centre along X; it must fit on the floor.

navigation.description: The navigation bounds cover the whole floor.

heightZ.description: Height of the navigation bounds, centred on the floor's top face.
